contracts.invariant: VM roots thunk before GC; context roots it before member commit; thread reloads after sync; marker allocation reloads registered cell; entry marker invalidates before retirement. Legacy raw SFUN registration is still unqualified.

contracts.source: setup.c created-thread entry gate; old-set OP_SET_PROCESSOR_COUNT; new-set finish
contracts.invariant: Threads are created while parked outside Scheme/TLS participation. Publish members only after all setups and creates succeed; then release entry and consume completion with the new set.

contracts.source: setup.c abort/join/cleanup; os_thread.c create/join return-code adapters
contracts.invariant: Known create failure has no child. Abort releases created threads to return without Scheme; cleanup/refund only after every join succeeds. Interrupted call or failed/unknown join retains slots, roots and grant, blocks GC/reuse/cleanup. No owner-death takeover is inferred.
contracts.retired: errno-based pthread result decoding; ignored shrink join; reclaim without quiescence
contracts.cost: Fixed progress records, cancellation exclusion on POSIX; unknown state sacrifices progress rather than custody

contracts.invariant: Reject RC/native borrowed, foreign-effectful and extra retained-marker domains before shrinking. Admitted entry invalidates on its owner; after join move still ownership to active collector context instead of treating context death as object death. Unmanaged raw writers and nested FFI remain open.
contracts.retired: Unconditional free_still_objs/cleanup_rc on successful member retirement
contracts.cost: Admission walk and still-chain splice; stricter refusal for domains without freeze/effect receipts

proofs.premise: Unmodified predecessor p11: six total/two assigned before GC; six total after GC; third new context fails. Read-only process memory, not acceptance or cost measurement.
Concrete ledger phases, parked native threads, no-publication-before-create, failure/unknown custody and two membership sets; finite histories only.
Conditional physical capacity, initialized/created coverage, refund after quiescence and roots retained on unknown result. Actual allocator/atomic steps require C refinement.
Exact new source/profile complete bootstrap, host-budget map/continuation/GC, resize cycles and actual create/join fault controls; never import old pass.
OPEN: full barrier memory model, nonlocal escape/stop receipts, raw FFI writers, allocator interruption, retired processor identity and destructor affinity; no unconditional recovery claim.

resume.invariant: Let F=MSECTION_FUDGE, O=normal overflow reserve, W=MSECTION_SIZE. R=ceil((O+4F)/W). Capacity covers assigned+2*new+actual restore endpoints+R. Charge only startup pairs; R remains VM-unassigned. Then global available words are at least 4F and the first stack allowance at least F before its physical limit.
resume.retirement: A physical allocation receipt without a nonzero logical resume allowance is insufficient. Remove the zero-headroom grant and policy contraction that recreates it after GC.
resume.cost: On the observed 64-bit profile O=204808, F=8194, W=131072, so R=2 sections. These two MiB are derived capacity, not measured RSS or claimed net overhead versus a correct allocator.
resume.open: Caller B coverage, arbitrary foreign allocation, bounds on simultaneous allocation, memory ordering, owner death and all C-to-model refinements remain conditional; no commit admission.

questions.condition: A future isolated root/native custody domain must prove which writers can still touch quarantined objects before allowing healthy participants to collect. The current whole-VM refusal is a safety restriction, not that domain design.
questions.counterexample: A join error can retain a native handle indefinitely. The current guard then refuses GC for the entire VM; a safety exit cannot demonstrate continued useful Scheme execution or independent collector liveness.
